newsitem.title: USA: IRS's Dolan - about $90 bln U.S. taxes uncollected.
newsitem.headline: IRS's Dolan - about $90 bln U.S. taxes uncollected.

text.p: About $90 billion in taxes that should be collected remain uncollected in any one year, Michael Dolan, deputy commissioner at the Internal Revenue Service, said Thursday.

His comment was in response to a question by Sen. Richard Durbin, an Illinois Democrat, at a congressional hearing. Durbin later commented that if that revenue were able to be collected it could help efforts to lower the budget deficit.
